name: manual_56369a
claim: Before moving a scheduled reminder, read the script it runs: a year or one-time guard can make a new calendar date do nothing. Rehearse the script with stand-in tools for the target date, then verify the trigger the scheduler actually loaded.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-28: both certificate reminders were calendar jobs whose script exited unless the year was 2026, so moving only the dates to January 2027 would have failed silently.

rationale: 2026-11-28: both certificate reminders were calendar jobs whose script exited unless the year was 2026, so moving only the dates to January 2027 would have failed silently.
